verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs confirm that cardholders can add Adyen-issued cards to Apple Pay and Google Pay, with network tokens replacing the card data and lifecycle webhooks sent. That implies wallet tokenization works, but it reads only as cardholder-initiated adding. Missing for 10: documented in-app push provisioning SDK/API, Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, explicit manual provisioning fallback docs, independent corroboration.
